intro: The Bundle of Crocolisk Skins is a prepared package of cured reptilian hides harvested from the dangerous marshes of the Wetlands. Destined for the leatherworkers of Menethil Harbor, it serves as valuable trade stock for crafting sturdy boots and tough harbor gear.

p: The vast waterways of the Wetlands are teeming with crocolisks, whose tough, water-resistant hides are an essential commodity for the coastal settlement of Menethil Harbor. Hunters braving the bogs collect and cure these skins before sending them westward to local artisans like James Halloran. However, this particular bundle took an unusual detour into an adventurer's hands: the hunter Einar sought a courier purely to avoid returning to town and facing the temper of his frustrated wife, Sida.
